meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas. doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.title: Genetics: influence of TOR kinase on lifespan in C. elegans

evidence.label: Animal model
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: Silencing the single worm TOR gene roughly doubled C. elegans lifespan, showing the longevity role of TOR inhibition is conserved across an enormous evolutionary distance.

extracted_findings.effect: RNAi of C. elegans TOR roughly doubles adult lifespan, acting largely parallel to insulin/IGF-1-DAF-16
